Tool names here are Academic Harness's own. In Claude Code, `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, `ask_user_question` is `AskUserQuestion`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## Meta-analysis

`meta_analysis` pools pairwise effects after extraction is complete. `start` freezes the effect measure, model (fixed/random), τ² method (DL/PM/REML), CI method (normal/Hartung–Knapp), and alpha; do not change the protocol silently. `add` accepts raw 2×2, continuous, correlation, HR, diagnostic 2×2, or effect+CI/SE inputs; for ratio measures pass `log_effect`/`log_se` or an effect with a confidence interval, and metadata such as `alloc`, `dose`, `rob`, or `design` is preserved for `subgroup`/`meta_regression`. `import_review` reads complete extraction rows and skips conflicted or incomplete rows with reasons. `pool` reports the estimate, CI, Q, I², τ², prediction interval, and warnings; `subgroup`, `meta_regression`, `leave_one_out`, `publication_bias` (Egger, Begg, funnel; trim-and-fill is not implemented), and `diagnostic` (univariate logit pooling, not bivariate/HSROC) are separate analyses. Never describe a pooled estimate as significant, effective, certain, or clinically recommended; report the numbers, model, assumptions, and warnings. Load the `meta-analysis` skill.
